text: Millest on hommik vanasõna järgi targem?
gloss: According to the proverb, the morning is wiser than what? — The evening: «Hommik on õhtust targem» (sleep on it).

text: Mis värvi on multifilmide väikesed metsaelanikud smurfid?
gloss: What colour are the little forest-dwelling Smurfs of the cartoons? — Blue.

text: Mis kuupäeval on jaanilaupäev, mil süüdatakse jaanituli ja otsitakse sõnajalaõit?
gloss: On what date is Midsummer Eve, when bonfires are lit and people look for the fern flower? — 23 June. 24 June is Midsummer Day itself (jaanipäev), the trap.

text: Milline lind kannab Eesti rahvuslinnu tiitlit?
gloss: Which bird is Estonia's national bird? — The barn swallow (suitsupääsuke).

text: Sõber ütleb, et buss väljub kolmveerand kaheksa. Mis kell buss väljub?
gloss: A friend says the bus leaves at 'three quarters eight'. What time is that? — 7.45: Estonian counts towards the coming hour, so three quarters of the way to eight. 8.45 is the trap for literal readers.

text: Millises ilmakaares on päike Eestis keskpäeval?
gloss: In which direction is the sun at midday in Estonia? — South: north of the tropics the noon sun is always due south. The aha: in Estonian 'lõuna' means both 'noon' and 'south'.

text: Ämblik ei ole putukas – seda reedab juba tema jalgade arv. Mitu jalga on ämblikul?
gloss: A spider is not an insect, as its leg count shows. How many legs does a spider have? — 8 (insects have 6).

text: Mis puuviljast saadakse kuivatamise teel rosinad?
gloss: Which fruit is dried to make raisins? — The grape. Dried plums are prunes, dried apricots are apricots.

text: Hommikul näitas kraadiklaas −5 °C, lõunaks oli läinud 8 kraadi soojemaks. Mitu kraadi oli lõunal?
gloss: The thermometer showed −5 °C in the morning; by noon it was 8 degrees warmer. What was the temperature? — +3 °C (−5 + 8). −13 and +13 catch autopilot arithmetic.

text: Mis loom on Leiutajatekülas elav multifilmitegelane Lotte?
gloss: What animal is Lotte, the cartoon character from Gadgetville? — A dog (the Estonian animated films 'Lotte from Gadgetville', 'Lotte and the Moonstone Secret').

text: Kui liita sõnad „jää“ ja „äär“, saab liitsõna, milles on haruldaselt palju sama tähte järjest. Mitu ä-tähte seal kõrvuti seisab?
gloss: Joining 'jää' (ice) and 'äär' (edge) gives a compound with an unusual run of one letter. How many ä's in a row? — 4: jää + äär = jäääär (2 + 2). Many people say 3.

text: Mis nime kannab paik, kus elavad A. H. Tammsaare „Tõe ja õiguse“ igavesti tülitsevad naabrid Andres ja Pearu?
gloss: What is the place where the feuding neighbours Andres and Pearu of Tammsaare's 'Truth and Justice' live? — Vargamäe. Paunvere is Luts's, Kõrboja another Tammsaare novel, Mahtra Vilde's.

text: Tallinna raekoja torni tipus seisab sõdurikujuline tuulelipp. Kuidas teda rahvasuus kutsutakse?
gloss: A soldier-shaped weathervane stands on top of Tallinn Town Hall's tower. What is it popularly called? — Old Thomas (Vana Toomas). The others are Tallinn towers.

text: Milline 2003. aastal käivitatud internetikõnede programm valmis suuresti Eesti programmeerijate käe all?
gloss: Which internet-calling program launched in 2003 was largely built by Estonian programmers? — Skype (Ahti Heinla, Priit Kasesalu, Jaan Tallinn).

text: Milline neist tähtedest on eesti tähestikus olemas, aga puudub nii soome kui ka saksa tähestikust?
gloss: Which of these letters is in the Estonian alphabet but in neither the Finnish nor the German one? — Õ. Finnish has Ä and Ö, German has Ä, Ö and Ü; only Õ is Estonian alone.

text: Kui Tallinnas on talvel keskpäev, mis kell on siis Londonis?
gloss: When it is noon in Tallinn in winter, what time is it in London? — 10.00: Estonia is UTC+2 in winter, London UTC+0, and London is west, so earlier.

text: Laulupidude lahutamatu osa on laul „Mu isamaa on minu arm“, mille viisi lõi Gustav Ernesaks. Kes kirjutas selle sõnad?
gloss: 'My Fatherland Is My Love', set to music by Gustav Ernesaks, is a fixture of the song festivals. Who wrote the words? — Lydia Koidula.

text: Vana maja fassaadile on ehitusaasta kirjutatud rooma numbritega: MCMXII. Mis aastal maja valmis?
gloss: An old house shows its year in Roman numerals: MCMXII. Which year? — 1912: M = 1000, CM = 900, XII = 12.

text: Õhutühjas ruumis lastakse samal hetkel lahti linnusulg ja kivi. Kumb jõuab enne põrandale?
gloss: In a vacuum a feather and a stone are dropped together. Which lands first? — Both at once: without air resistance everything falls with the same acceleration (shown on the Moon by Apollo 15).

text: Millises riigis asub inkade mägilinn Machu Picchu?
gloss: In which country is the Inca mountain city Machu Picchu? — Peru. The others were also part of the Inca Empire.

text: Emakeelepäeva tähistatakse 14. märtsil, sest siis sündis luuletaja, keda peetakse eestikeelse luule rajajaks. Kes ta on?
gloss: Mother Tongue Day is 14 March, the birthday of the poet seen as the founder of Estonian-language poetry. Who? — Kristjan Jaak Peterson (born 14 March 1801).

text: Peipsi on Eesti suurim järv, kuid me jagame seda naabriga. Milline on suurim järv, mis jääb tervenisti Eesti piiridesse?
gloss: Peipus is Estonia's largest lake but shared with a neighbour. Which is the largest lake entirely within Estonia? — Võrtsjärv (about 270 km²).

text: Erki Nool tuli 2000. aastal Sydneys olümpiavõitjaks alal, mille nimi ütleb ühtlasi, mitmest alast see koosneb. Mitu ala see on?
gloss: Erki Nool became Olympic champion in Sydney 2000 in an event whose name says how many events it has. How many? — 10: the decathlon (kümnevõistlus). 7 is the women's heptathlon.

text: Lauset „Aias sadas saia“ tuuakse tihti näiteks ühe eripära tõttu. Mis see eripära on?
options: Selles pole ühtegi kaashäälikut peale s-i
Seda saab lugeda ka tagantpoolt ettepoole
Igas sõnas on täpselt neli tähte
gloss: 'It rained bread in the garden' is often quoted for one peculiarity. What? — It is a palindrome (aiassadassaia). The others fail on inspection: 'sadas' has a d and five letters, 'Aias' starts with A.

text: Milline 1969. aasta film põhineb Eduard Bornhöhe jutustusel „Vürst Gabriel ehk Pirita kloostri viimsed päevad“?
gloss: Which 1969 film is based on Bornhöhe's 'Prince Gabriel, or the Last Days of Pirita Convent'? — 'The Last Relic' (Viimne reliikvia). 'Kevade' is also from 1969, but from Luts's novel.

text: Ühes anumas on liiter vett, teises liiter jääd. Kumma sisu kaalub rohkem?
gloss: Which weighs more, a litre of water or a litre of ice? — A litre of water: ice is less dense (it floats), so the same volume weighs less. Many think 'the same', mixing it up with a kilo of each.

text: Millise pilli itaaliakeelne täisnimi tähendab sõna-sõnalt „vaikne-vali“, sest erinevalt eelkäijast sai sellel mängida nii vaikselt kui ka valjult?
gloss: Which instrument's full Italian name means 'soft-loud', because unlike its predecessor it could play both? — The piano (pianoforte). The harpsichord, its predecessor, cannot vary volume by touch.

text: Rosetta kivi aitas lahti muukida Egiptuse hieroglüüfid, sest sama tekst oli sellele raiutud ka ühes hästi tuntud keeles. Millises?
gloss: The Rosetta Stone helped decipher hieroglyphs because the same text was also carved in a well-known language. Which? — Ancient Greek (the third script is Demotic Egyptian).

text: Claude Monet’ maal päikesetõusust Le Havre’i sadamas sai 1874. aasta näitusel ühe kriitiku pilkesõna kaudu terve kunstivoolu nimeandjaks. Millise voolu?
gloss: Monet's sunrise over Le Havre harbour gave its name to a whole movement through a critic's jibe at the 1874 exhibition. Which? — Impressionism ('Impression, soleil levant').

text: Bait koosneb kaheksast bitist ja iga bitt on kas 0 või 1. Mitu erinevat väärtust saab ühte baiti salvestada?
gloss: A byte is eight bits, each 0 or 1. How many different values can a byte hold? — 256: 2 to the power of 8. 8 and 16 catch those who add or double instead of multiplying.

text: „Kalevipoja“ lõpus raiub kangelase enda mõõk, mis jõe põhjas teda ootas, tal jalad otsast. Millises jões see juhtub?
gloss: At the end of 'Kalevipoeg' the hero's own sword, waiting in a riverbed, cuts off his legs. In which river? — The Kääpa, where he had thrown the cursed sword.

text: Arvo Pärdi 1970. aastatel loodud kompositsioonitehnika nimi tuleb ladinakeelsest sõnast, mis tähendab kellukesi. Kuidas seda tehnikat nimetatakse?
gloss: Arvo Pärt's 1970s compositional technique is named from the Latin for little bells. What is it called? — Tintinnabuli. Dodecaphony and pointillism are other 20th-century techniques, spectralism a French school.

text: Milline Tartu ülikoolis õppinud teadlane avastas imetajate munaraku ja teda peetakse embrüoloogia rajajaks?
gloss: Which scientist educated at the University of Tartu discovered the mammalian egg cell and is seen as the founder of embryology? — Karl Ernst von Baer. All four are Tartu names: astronomer, surgeon, explorer.

text: Mis Rooma keisri nime kannab Põhja-Inglismaal üle kogu saare kulgev kivimüür?
gloss: Which Roman emperor gave his name to the stone wall running across northern England? — Hadrian. Claudius began the conquest of Britain, the trap.

text: Milline Euroopa riik piirneb ainult kahe riigiga – Hispaania ja Prantsusmaaga?
gloss: Which European country borders only Spain and France? — Andorra, in the Pyrenees. Monaco borders only France, San Marino only Italy.

text: Croissant (eesti keeles sarvesai) sai nime oma kuju järgi ja sõna tuleb prantsuse verbist croître – „kasvama“. Mida see nimi tähendab?
gloss: The croissant (in Estonian 'horn bun') is named after its shape, from the French verb 'to grow'. What does the name mean? — Crescent, the waxing moon. 'Horn' is the trap from the Estonian name; 'rising dough' fits the verb but not the shape.

text: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry raamatu kangelane Väike prints tuli Maale pisikeselt asteroidilt. Mis tähise all seda asteroidi raamatus mainitakse?
gloss: The Little Prince came to Earth from a tiny asteroid. Under what designation is it mentioned? — B 612.

text: Milline mänguasjafirma sai oma nime taanikeelsest väljendist, mis tähendab „mängi hästi“?
gloss: Which toy company is named from a Danish phrase meaning 'play well'? — LEGO, from 'leg godt'. Playmobil is German, Mattel and Hasbro American.

text: Milline olend on Šotimaa ametlik rahvusloom?
gloss: Which creature is Scotland's official national animal? — The unicorn. The lion is on the royal standard, the trap.

text: Eesti keeles ei ole „biljon“ sama mis ingliskeelne „billion“. Kui palju on eesti biljon?
gloss: In Estonian 'biljon' is not the English 'billion'. How much is it? — A thousand milliards, i.e. a million million (10^12): Estonian uses the long scale. A thousand million is the English billion, Estonian 'miljard'.

text: Eesti astronoom Ernst Öpik oletas 1932. aastal, et pika perioodiga komeedid pärinevad Päikesesüsteemi kaugeimast äärealast. Mis nime see piirkond praegu enamasti kannab?
gloss: In 1932 Ernst Öpik proposed that long-period comets come from the outermost region of the Solar System. What is it usually called today? — The Oort cloud (also Öpik–Oort cloud). The Kuiper belt is the source of short-period comets.

text: Sõna „raamat“ on väga vana laensõna, mis tähendas lähtekeeles kirja või ürikut. Mis keelest see on eesti keelde tulnud?
gloss: 'Raamat' (book) is a very old loanword that meant a letter or charter in its source. From which language? — Old Russian, from грамота (itself from Greek grammata).

text: Kes projekteeris titaaniplaatidega kaetud Guggenheimi muuseumi Bilbaos?
gloss: Who designed the titanium-clad Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao? — Frank Gehry (opened 1997).

text: Kui paavst Gregorius XIII 1582. aastal kalendrit parandas, järgnes neljapäevale, 4. oktoobrile, kohe reede. Mis kuupäev see reede oli?
gloss: When Gregory XIII reformed the calendar in 1582, Thursday 4 October was followed directly by Friday. Which date? — 15 October: ten days were dropped, so 4 → 15 (14 is the off-by-one trap).

text: Maailmas on vaid kaks riiki, millel pole merele pääsu ja mille kõigil naabritel samuti pole. Üks on Usbekistan. Milline Euroopa riik on teine?
gloss: Only two countries are landlocked with all neighbours landlocked too. One is Uzbekistan; which European one is the other? — Liechtenstein (neighbours Switzerland and Austria). Switzerland and Austria border Italy/Germany, Luxembourg borders Belgium.

text: Mitmest ooperist koosneb Richard Wagneri tsükkel „Nibelungi sõrmus“?
gloss: How many operas make up Wagner's 'Ring of the Nibelung'? — Four: Das Rheingold, Die Walküre, Siegfried, Götterdämmerung.

text: Orson Wellesi filmis „Kodanik Kane“ sosistab peategelane surres sõna „Rosebud“. Mis see lõpuks osutub olevat?
gloss: In 'Citizen Kane' the hero whispers 'Rosebud' as he dies. What does it turn out to be? — His childhood sled.

text: Esimesed taliolümpiamängud peeti 1924. aastal samas riigis, kus samal aastal toimusid suvemängud Pariisis. Millises linnas?
gloss: The first Winter Olympics were held in 1924 in the same country as that year's Paris Summer Games. In which town? — Chamonix, France; the only French option. St. Moritz hosted in 1928, Lake Placid 1932, Oslo 1952.

text: Vanillikaun on tegelikult ühe troopilise ronitaime vili. Millisesse taimesugukonda see taim kuulub?
gloss: The vanilla pod is the fruit of a tropical climbing plant. Which plant family is it? — The orchids (käpalised). The 'pod' tempts towards legumes, the climbing habit towards the pepper family.

text: 1947. aastal leiti Harvardi arvuti Mark II releest putukas, mis kleebiti logiraamatusse märkusega, et see on esimene päris „bug“. Mis putukas see oli?
gloss: In 1947 an insect was found in a relay of the Harvard Mark II and taped into the log as the first actual 'bug'. What insect? — A moth.
